entities.name: Adam Carthalion
entities.description: Lord of Castle Melmereth of House Scarlet in Ephren on Corondor, who sought planeswalker power and died fighting Ravidel.

entities.name: Ravidel
entities.description: Spellsquire who answered to a higher force and persuaded Adam to sacrifice his wife.

entities.name: Eusomoné
entities.description: Minotaur loyal to Adam, given his sword.

entities.name: Battle of Aster Fall
entities.description: Battle where Adam confronted Ravidel and died.

events.summary: Adam gives a boon to the minotaurs and gains Eusomoné's loyalty.
events.quote: He gave a boon to the minotaurs, gaining Eusomoné 's loyalty.

events.summary: Ravidel persuades Adam to sacrifice his wife Gwendolyn Mor in exchange for power.
events.quote: Ravidel even persuaded him to sacrifice his wife Gwendolyn Mor in exchange for power.

events.summary: Adam backs out of sacrificing his infant son Jared and entrusts him to Ezer.
events.quote: He instead entrusted his spellsquire Ezer with Jared

events.summary: Adam sacrifices himself with Backdraft against Ravidel, who is only wounded.
events.quote: Though Adam sacrificed himself to fulfill the spell, Ravidel was only wounded.

relations.quote: confronted Ravidel head-on in the Battle of Aster Fall
